description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys update session functionality, specifically testing success, failure due to non-existent session, and failure due to session API errors.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysUpdateSessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, setting up media keys and key session for testing update session functionality.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysUpdateSessionTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing media keys and key session for tests.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test that updateSession succeeds when called with valid session and data.

methods.name: SessionDoesNotExistFailure
methods.description: Test that updateSession fails with BAD_SESSION_ID when the session does not exist.

methods.name: SessionFailure
methods.description: Test that updateSession fails with INVALID_STATE when the session API reports an error.
